verdicts.reason: A has a clean vertical flow, but the legal line is set as large as a subhead right under the headline. The CTA is nearly as wide as the canvas and sits above the chips, and the chips are re-ordered into a long stack that crowds the bottom. B breaks the design apart: the five chips are scattered (ROSEMARY tiny in the top-left corner, BLOOD ORANGE and WILD HONEY floating around the can, two more below the CTA). The SOLSTICE logo is shrunk into the corner circle, the legal copy is large, and the CTA is small and buried under that text.
